FN-XVF17Z-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 87
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Representative Parker Moore
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 03/24/2023
House Bill 87 as introduced could increase the training expenses reimbursed by public entities
that hire law enforcement officers, certified corrections officers or firefighters that were
previously employed by another public entity within 36 months of the employee's completion of
certain required training, instead of within 24 months, as provided by current law. This bill
could further increase the obligations of those public entities that hire such trained employees by
an undetermined amount dependent on the cost of fitted uniforms that may be reimbursed
pursuant to this bill. This bill could correspondingly increase training expenses recovered by
public entities when such trained employees are hired by other public entities.

FN-XVF17Z-2
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 87
Committee: Finance and Taxation General Fund Sponsor: Representative Parker Moore
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 05/09/2023
House Bill 87 as passed the House of Representatives could increase the training expenses
reimbursed by public entities that hire law enforcement officers, certified corrections officers or
firefighters that were previously employed by another public entity within 36 months of the
employee's completion of certain required training, instead of within 24 months, as provided by
current law. This bill could further increase the obligations of those public entities that hire such
trained employees by an undetermined amount dependent on the cost of certain fitted uniform
items that may be reimbursed pursuant to this bill. This bill could correspondingly increase
training expenses recovered by public entities when such trained employees are hired by other
public entities.
